card.name: Inside ALL-CAPS words in headings
card.fires_on: Ending pieces of long words written in all capitals, such as warning headings in drug labels. It also fires on short all-caps words like THE and IN<<I>> in titles.

modes.label: Caps medical terms
modes.description: Later pieces of long capitalized medical words in boxed warning headings.
modes.example: WARNING: VALVULAR HEART DISEASE and PULMONARY ARTER<<IAL>> HYPERTENSION FINTEPLA

modes.label: Caps administration warnings
modes.description: Endings of capitalized words in instructions about how a drug is given.
modes.example: DO NOT ADMINISTER VIA AN INTRAVEN<<OUS>> PUSH.

modes.label: Caps non-medical titles
modes.description: Short or ending pieces in capitalized titles, including Indonesian text.
modes.example: BUKU IN<<I>> DI TULIS PADA TAH

card.writes: It favors capital-letter starts of the next word and disfavors hyphenated or odd pieces, so the output continues with a new capitalized word.
card.plain: It fires in the middle of words typed in all capitals, like headings in a boxed warning.
